background.overview: Coinbase Global, Inc. is a leading cryptocurrency exchange platform that allows users to buy, sell, and store various cryptocurrencies. Founded in 2012, it has become one of the most recognized names in the crypto space, providing a user-friendly interface and a range of services including trading, staking, and educational resources.
